description_en: Creates an instance. If you call this operation, an order for a new instance is created and the order is automatically paid for. You cannot create Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instances or ApsaraDB RDS instances by calling the operation
description_zh: 创建一个实例资源，会创建一个新购实例资源的订单，并自动支付。不支持ECS和RDS系列产品的创建
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi create-instance --product-code Cdn --product-type Cdn --subscription-type Subscription --period 12 --renewal-status ManualRenewal --renew-period 12 --client-token JASIOFKVNVIXXXXXX --logistics '{"cityCode":"330100","cityName":"杭州","contactName":"测试","countryCode":"","districtName":"浦沿街道","email":"**@example.com","mobilePhone":"153564848844","phone":"1234567","provCode":"330000","provName":"浙江省","streetCode":"33010610","streetName":"转塘","zipCode":"0000"}' --parameter Value=disk Code=InstanceType --pricing-cycle 2 --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The code of the service to which the instance belongs. You can query the service code by calling the QueryProductList operation or viewing Codes of Alibaba Cloud Services
parameters.help_zh: 产品代码。可通过接口QueryProductList查询产品代码
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Subscription: the subscription billing method.
PayAsYouGo: the pay-as-you-go billing method
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Unit: month. The value must be an integral multiple of 12.

This parameter is required if you create a subscription instance
parameters.help_zh: 预付费周期。单位为月，按年付费产品请输入12的整数倍
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The renewal method. Valid values:

AutoRenewal: The instance is automatically renewed.
ManualRenewal: The instance is manually renewed.

Default value: ManualRenewal
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费状态，取值：
AutoRenewal：自动续费。
ManualRenewal：手动续费。

默认ManualRenewal
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Unit: month.

This parameter is required if the RenewalStatus parameter is set to AutoRenewal
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期， 单位为月。
当设置RenewalStatus为AutoRenewal时，必须设置
parameters.name: renew_period

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The server checks whether a request that uses the same client token has been received. If a request that uses the same client token has been received, the server returns the same request result as the previous request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等参数，服务端会查询是否有相同ClientToken的请求，如果有，直接返回上次调用结果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.example: {"cityCode":"330100","cityName":"杭州","contactName":"测试","countryCode":"","districtName":"浦沿街道","email":"**@example.com","mobilePhone":"153564848844","phone":"1234567","provCode":"330000","provName":"浙江省","streetCode":"33010610","streetName":"转塘","zipCode":"0000"}
parameters.help_en: The logistics address of this order. This parameter is generally valid for physical orders
parameters.help_zh: 本次订单的物流信息地址，一般对实物类订单有效
parameters.name: logistics

fields.help_en: The value property of the Nth module. Value of N: 1 to 100
fields.help_zh: 第n个模块属性value配置，n的取值范围为（1~100）
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The code property of the Nth module. Value of N: 1 to 100. If multiple module property parameters are involved, concatenate multiple parameters based on the value of N in sequence
fields.help_zh: 第n个模块属性code配置，n的取值范围为（1~100），如有多个模块属性参数，按照n=1,2,3…n的形式拼接多个参数
fields.name: code

parameters.help_zh:
预付费周期的周期类型

PricingCycle=1-表示预付费周期的单位是年；

PricingCycle=2-表示预付费周期的单位是月；

PricingCycle=3-表示预付费周期的单位是天；

默认值：PricingCycle=2

仅限于部分产品类型使用（ProductType为ddos_originpre_public_cn、ddosDip、ddoscoo、ddos_originpre_public_intl、ddosDip_intl、ddoscoo_intl）
parameters.name: pricing_cycle
